approvedByExistingContracts.statement: Facility and Legacy rewards are credited only after a player claim action.
Generated opportunities and ready claims do not expire.
Offline settlement may generate opportunities and advance committed timers, but may not choose, resolve, serve, transfer stock, or claim.
Claims are exact-once through the trusted finalizer and retained receipt/archive contract.
These phases add no stamina, global currency, daily reset, daily checklist, or permanent percentage multiplier.
Waystone and Legacy remain at the central-crystal physical Village anchor.
Restaurant uses the western-plaza-restaurant anchor with western-plaza as the predecessor alias.
Restaurant uses customers, recipes, preparation stations, service choices, local reputation, recipe mastery, visitors, and manual claims.
All 18 Fellows and 20 Family remain scheduled; only joined Fellows may speak.
Dialogue uses approved transparent cutout, approved framed treatment, or attributed text-only; never an unframed full-background portrait overlay.
Definition, policy, tutorial, content, receipt, and archive versions remain explicit and immutable after use.

candidateRecommendations.why: Released Phase 13 tier/feat payloads remain byte-semantic v1; new value starts only at distinct successor/new source identities.
Three standard ready claims reduce tap repetition while preserving every canonical reward and individual major claims.
Twelve bank slots cover six unattended hours and fit the shared 24-hour settlement boundary without becoming a daily reset.
A bounded visible queue keeps storage and mobile UI predictable; full queues pause generation rather than expiring entries.
Existing saves start at the same causal boundary as new saves; no fabricated historical customers.
Fifty-two captured fixed rows reduce boundary payout jumps to at most 15.05% and scale conservatively without a live percentage multiplier.
Active Village play accelerates passive progress without becoming mandatory.
Three short recipes and two single-slot stations prove choice, local unlocks, ready-stock banking, and serving without a new resource economy.
The first slice tests preparation and stock without introducing an unapproved ingredient economy; missing/different policy fails closed.

candidateRecommendations.value: Reputation and recipe mastery thresholds 0/12/36 with +1/+2/+3 by result
candidateRecommendations.why: The first three levels unfold over multiple sessions and reward matching without a permanent percentage bonus.

candidateRecommendations.value: Jaina route envoy at Reputation 3 plus story event
candidateRecommendations.why: Keeps the accepted cast hook and demonstrates non-expiring authored visitors and Chronicle recording.
Contextual, skippable lessons appear only after their concept exists; migrated/rank-jump saves get at most one automatic lesson per safe visit.
Original, short, localization-keyed Everstead copy can be reviewed independently of mechanics and speakers.
A one-megabyte incremental five-year budget is conservative while the archive-folding seam keeps recent exact receipts bounded.
